overview.description: Selling before the product is finished is not dishonest, it is how anything hard gets built. The dishonest version is promising a date.
objectives: Map every stakeholder in a scientific purchase, including the one who can only say no
Navigate procurement, vendor onboarding, insurance and compliance requirements
Run an enterprise or pharma sales cycle without losing a year to it
